Field.Label: Listen Port:
Field.Description: TCP port the plugin listens on for Ecowitt gateway pushes (default 45000). Must be 1024–65535.

Field.Label: Listen Path:
Field.Description: HTTP path for incoming data (default /data/report). Must start with /.

Field.Label: Display Units:
Field.Description: Preferred unit system for Indigo device states. When the gateway sends the opposite unit system, values are auto-converted.

Field.Label: Enable Debug Logging
Field.Description: Logs each sensor update individually. Produces high log volume during normal operation.
